description: On 15 January 1919, a storage tank at the Purity Distilling Company in Boston, MA burst, releasing 2.3 million gallons of molasses. The resulting flood destroyed nearby buildings and claimed the lives of 21 people. In order to better visualize the scale of the disaster, this photograph (originally published in the Globe Newspaper shortly after the event) has been annotated to show the approximate size, shape, and location of the tank before its collapse.
